cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(TEMPESTPeer VERSION 2.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)
if(NOT TARGET TEMPEST::Messaging)
    find_package(TEMPESTMessaging CONFIG QUIET)
    if(NOT TARGET TEMPEST::Messaging)
        if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/messaging/CMakeLists.txt")
            add_subdirectory(vendor/messaging ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/messaging)
        else()
            add_subdirectory(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../messaging ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/messaging)
        endif()
    endif()
endif()
find_package(cppzmq CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(nlohmann_json CONFIG REQUIRED)
add_library(TEMPESTPeer src/zmq_peer.cpp)
add_library(TEMPEST::Peer ALIAS TEMPESTPeer)
set_target_properties(TEMPESTPeer PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME Peer POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_compile_features(TEMPESTPeer PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(TEMPESTPeer PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}>)
target_link_libraries(TEMPESTPeer PUBLIC TEMPEST::Messaging nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json PRIVATE cppzmq)
install(TARGETS TEMPESTPeer EXPORT TEMPESTPeerTargets ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
install(EXPORT TEMPESTPeerTargets NAMESPACE TEMPEST:: DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/TEMPESTPeer)
configure_package_config_file(cmake/TEMPESTPeerConfig.cmake.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/TEMPESTPeerConfig.cmake
    INSTALL_DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/TEMPESTPeer)
write_basic_package_version_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/TEMPESTPeerConfigVersion.cmake
    VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION} COMPATIBILITY SameMajorVersion)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/TEMPESTPeerConfig.cmake ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/TEMPESTPeerConfigVersion.cmake
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/TEMPESTPeer)

if(PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL)
    include(CTest)
    if(BUILD_TESTING AND EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/zmq_peer_test.cpp")
        add_subdirectory(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../sdk/dartwic-engine-protocol ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/engine-protocol)
        add_executable(tempest_zmq_peer_test tests/zmq_peer_test.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(tempest_zmq_peer_test PRIVATE TEMPEST::Peer DARTWIC::EngineProtocol)
        add_test(NAME tempest_zmq_peer COMMAND tempest_zmq_peer_test)
        set_tests_properties(tempest_zmq_peer PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 30)
    endif()
endif()

if(PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL)
    add_executable(TEMPESTPeer_Example EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL examples/peer.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(TEMPESTPeer_Example PRIVATE TEMPEST::Peer)
endif()
